role: DSV4F TOKEN_NS residual attribution. Instrumentation / accounting only. No operator, kernel, or residency change.
label: DIRTY_ENGINEERING
label_reason: Authority numbers are the host-wall warm R6 body already on disk. Other ascent lanes were running. The one GPU confirmation was page-cache cold and is not a timing claim.
gpu_time_definition: MTLCommandBuffer.GPUEndTime - GPUStartTime after wait. CPU wait is not GPU time.
did_not_optimize: No DSV4F operator or kernel change.
Did not open the resident <=1.5 path.
Did not weaken a gate, assertion, or seal.

open_number.note: Identity balanced only because 26.86% of the token was an unnamed residual. Q80 residual is 0.73% and named inter_phase_gap_plus_seal_jitter.

class_split_of_former_275026398_ns.note: SERIAL on the token wall. Parallel-thread sums (reader.path_resolve, verify_ns) are not in this table. Named overlappable rows (shared I/O, prefetch_fill) identify the class but stay overlappable so they are not double-counted.

hidden_io.what: host.shared.w1/w2/w3_io + host.moe_control_io during attn GPU. min(attn_hole=129055000, named shared+control=110907091).
hidden_io.finding_for_later: Streamed shared/control reads exist because the 148 GiB model is not resident. dsv-resident-gravity owns deleting them.

buffer_lifecycle.what: host.mla.prefetch_fill of next-layer attn weights during moe GPU. min(moe_hole=92330000, prefetch_fill=92228375).
buffer_lifecycle.finding_for_later: Prefetch fill is a Metal scratch write of already-read attn weights. Residency deletes it.

other_cpu_feed.what: Remainder of sum(cb.host_wall)-(encode+submit+wait) after hidden_io and buffer_lifecycle: in-wall MHC/norm decode, Metal buffer writes in preload_moe_io, GPU-timestamp query after wait, Instant microsecond truncation.
other_cpu_feed.standing_class: other, explicitly named: in-wall table construction + CPU feed + timestamp query

lm_head_upload.what: GPU-idle host write of LM-head tiles into a Metal buffer after host.lm_head_io returns and before each lm_head CB. Previously classified as overlappable because name.contains("upload") assumed nesting in a parent I/O wall. It is not nested.
lm_head_upload.standing_class: buffer lifecycle / CPU feed (GPU-idle DRAM fill)
lm_head_upload.finding_for_later: 49.8 ms GPU-idle tile fill. Removable under a resident packed head. Not fixed here.

remaining_residual.name: inter_stage_gap_plus_in_wall_decode_doublecount_jitter
remaining_residual.what: 3.80 ms left on the authority R6 token (0.37%, under the 0.05 limit). On receipts that do not split decode, host.decode (19.1 ms serial) intersects the in-wall decode that also lives inside other_cpu_feed, so residual is slightly understated. New runs split host.decode vs host.decode_in_cb_overlap.

not_this_residual.CPU_feed_already_named_serial: host.mhc_pre 25.4 ms, host.decode 19.1 ms, host.rmsnorm 0.73 ms
not_this_residual.address_construction: reader.path_resolve 1318 ms is a parallel-thread sum, not token latency. Not this residual.

critical_path_honesty.trap_avoided_1: reader.path_resolve and verify_ns are parallel sums. They were not added to the exclusive serial set.
critical_path_honesty.trap_avoided_2: Copied the host-wall baseline shape: SERIAL vs OVERLAPPABLE vs parallel_sum_not_latency. Did not treat DSV4F_TOKEN_NS_LEDGER parallel sums as token latency.
critical_path_honesty.overlap_is_on_the_wall: Host work between commit and wait is inside cb.host_wall, so it is on the token even though the GPU is concurrently busy. metal.gpu stays overlappable. The hole is exclusive serial because body includes host_wall.

gpu_confirmation.label: DIRTY_ENGINEERING
gpu_confirmation.note: One GPU-locked token. Page-cache COLD (body 10.689 s vs warm authority 1.024 s). Discarded as a timing number. Used only to confirm new collector stages and that closure still holds.

correctness.gate: e2e |delta| <= 0.05 on greedy logit; token_id match; 0 fallbacks. Native HC SHA is the pre-existing native constant, not the CPU-oracle constant.
correctness.authority_r6_unchanged: This lane did not change operators or the oracle. R6 numbers are the same token.

findings_for_later.name: host.lm_head_upload is 49.8 ms GPU-idle on the warm token
findings_for_later.why: DSV4F is theory-only. Resident packed head deletes the fill.

findings_for_later.name: 221.5 ms of host work sits between commit and wait (shared I/O + prefetch_fill)
findings_for_later.why: Streamed source. dsv-resident-gravity owns deleting it. dsv-cb-collapse owns CB topology.
